 "data": "flowchart TD
 subgraph Indexing[\"Batch Indexing (CLI, run once)\"]
 A1[PDF Filings<br/>data/raw_pdfs/] --> A2[ingest.py<br/>Extract text page-by-page]
 A2 --> A3[Chunking<br/>Overlapping ~450-word chunks]
 A3 --> A4[embed_store.py<br/>Embed chunks - MiniLM CPU]
 A4 --> A5[(ChromaDB<br/>Persistent Store)]
 end

 subgraph Upload[\"Live Upload (UI, per session)\"]
 B1[Uploaded PDF] --> B2[ingest.py<br/>Extract text page-by-page]
 B2 --> B3[Chunking<br/>Overlapping ~450-word chunks]
 B3 --> B4[embed_store.py<br/>Embed chunks - MiniLM CPU]
 B4 --> B5[(ChromaDB<br/>In-Memory Collection)]
 end

 subgraph Query[\"Query Flow (shared logic)\"]
 C1[User Question] --> C2[Embed Question<br/>MiniLM CPU]
 C2 --> C3[Similarity Search]
 C3 --> C4[Top-k Retrieved Chunks<br/>with Company/Year/Page tags]
 C4 --> C5[Prompt Assembly<br/>Context + Question]
 C5 --> C6[Groq LLM<br/>Llama 3.3 - Free Tier]
 C6 --> C7[Cited Answer + Sources]
 end

 A5 -.queried by.-> C3
 B5 -.queried by.-> C3

 subgraph UI[\"Streamlit App\"]
 D1[Home - What is a 10-K]
 D2[Explore Filings]
 D3[Upload Your Own]
 D4[How It Works]
 D5[About the Project]
 end

 D2 -.uses.-> Query
 D3 -.uses.-> Upload
